name: The Fishing Derby
description: Anglers at the lake-country derby each landed a different fish from a different pond on a different lure. Work out who caught what, and where.
clues: Wade's weight is between the angler who landed the Catfish and the angler who landed the Bass.
The angler who landed the Trout's weight is higher than both the angler who landed the Catfish and the angler who landed the Perch.
If Crappie does not go with Cody, then 13 lb goes with Mabel.
Catfish, Crappie, and Perch go with Boone, Cody, and Dale, in some order.
Exactly two of (the members of the Catfish Family and Boone) go with (15 lb or 13 lb).
The catch with 9 lb belongs to the Sunfish Family if and only if either Wade does not go with Perch or Cody goes with Crappie (but not both).
Either 11 lb goes with Cody or Perch goes with 17 lb.
